notes: Houses gimbal and compute board; dry compartment (IP68).

Machined 6061 tube, hard-anodised. Bore holds the planetary flange ring.
Tether load path: Kevlar member clamps in the collet to the cap, never to the PCB. Pull-test 200 N.
Single-start, lead angle 3.58 deg: self-locking.
Flooded gearbox (marine grease). Sector slots are open by design; dry pods are separately sealed.
Waterjet 6061-T6 plate; D-hole keys it to the pivot shaft.
Keyed (D-flat) on the pivot shaft; teeth hobbed to match the worm.
Spec 'return_spring_retainer'. Hall sensor (DRV5055) on the cap reads the stub-pin magnet.
Spec 'arm_carriage': carries both axles + the drive pod.
Tooling: print 2 halves, mirror one. Sprue + 2 dowel pins.
Printed flat (axis vertical); D-bore, no supports.
Crown radius 18 mm; mu dry 0.75, wet 0.42.
Anti-fog: hydrophilic coating + 0.5 W heater trace on the flange; replaceable, O-ring sealed.
Continuous pan: ring gear (m0.5) driven by the static gearmotor; AS5600 magnet on the hub.
Joint range +/-45 deg, spring-centred.
Sits in a 1.5 mm groove behind the LED ring, 0.5 mm proud: takes wall strikes without shadowing the 45 deg LEDs.
Range kit: extends max pipe ID by 8 mm (to 208 mm). 6 per kit.

Self-locking worm (lead angle 3 deg), rated torque in bot_params.
